chunks: Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام used to prepare on Thursday for the Jumu'ah prayer.

key_terms.جَعْفَرٍ: Jaʿfar, the father in the Imam’s lineage
key_terms.لِلْجُمُعَةِ: for Jumu'ah, the Friday congregational observance
key_terms.مُوسَى: Mūsā, referring here to Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام prepare for Jumu'ah?
ai.summary: This report describes that Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام would prepare on Thursday for Jumu'ah. It indicates the importance of readiness and advance preparation for the Friday observance.
